lessons.title: Same Juice, Different Labels
lessons.goal: 分辨產品名稱、盲測資料與樣本限制。
lessons.story:
For a class project, Bella pours apple juice from one carton into two identical cups. She marks one “New Recipe” and the other “Regular Recipe.” Five classmates taste both without seeing the carton. Three choose the new recipe, one chooses the regular recipe, and one says they taste the same.

After the tasting, Bella reveals that both cups contain the same juice. Her classmates are surprised. She explains that this small activity cannot tell them exactly why each person chose a cup. The label may have influenced a choice, but chance or the order of tasting could also matter.

Next time, Bella plans to use simple letter labels and change which cup people taste first. Her report includes all five responses, including “the same.” She does not claim to have discovered a new, better juice.

words.example: Bella reveals the source of the juice.
A label may influence a choice.
Record every response in the report.

questions.prompt: Where does the juice in both cups come from?
questions.explanation: 兩杯均從同一盒蘋果汁倒出。
questions.evidence: Bella pours apple juice from one carton into two identical cups.
reasons: 標籤不同不代表配方不同。

questions.prompt: How many classmates choose the New Recipe cup?
questions.evidence: Three choose the new recipe, one chooses the regular recipe, and one says they taste the same.
reasons: 四是有選偏好杯的人總數。

questions.prompt: Why does Bella avoid saying the label caused every choice?
options: She forgot which label said New Recipe.
Other explanations are possible in this small activity.
questions.explanation: 她列出偶然、品嚐順序等其他可能，不可單憑小活動斷定。
questions.evidence: chance or the order of tasting could also matter.

options: Changes the flavor of a drink.
Pours juice into a new carton.
questions.explanation: 大家不知道同源，Bella告知之後驚訝，reveals指揭露。
questions.evidence: After the tasting, Bella reveals that both cups contain the same juice.

questions.prompt: What should a complete results table show?
questions.explanation: 不得把「一樣」併入另一組或省略，應保存全部五份回應。
questions.evidence: Her report includes all five responses, including “the same.”

questions.prompt: Which conclusion fits the activity best?
options: The new juice is proven to be better for every person.
Different labels accompanied different preferences, but the cause is not settled.
Any answer other than New Recipe should be removed.
Letter labels will guarantee identical answers next time.
questions.explanation: 標籤與選擇一起被觀察到，不代表已證明因果或產品優劣。
questions.evidence: She does not claim to have discovered a new, better juice.
reasons: 同一果汁且小樣本不支持全面優劣。
區分觀察與尚未確定的原因。
改設計也不能保證答案一致。
